finding: The original common record checker constructed MemberView with window={}. Its direct context-stop verifier requires the actual online_window_id, so a known non-generation budget boundary was misclassified as a required missing decision. MemberView with the original complete TeamRollout correctly retains prior actions. The v0.13.1 bridge forwards its explicit frozen window; no identity is guessed from the response.
admission_impact: prepare_window checks joint V.record before iterating active members. An unknown record gate excludes the whole slot, not only the context-limited member. This was conservative data exclusion, not fabricated reward or action success.

cases.selection: Legacy first context boundary and both declared v13 positive-reward slots; bounded diagnostic, not a new sampling batch.

limits: Original O0 rewards/V/support remain unchanged; posthoc v0.13.1 values are separate measurements using original scoped work facts. No model, GPU, SQL or world action was rerun.

O0 used evaluation mode with unchanged effective actor identity and zero actor/critic steps. Two handoff facts per interface are a limited matched development observation, not training gain or broad interface-effect statistics.
R1 and Vtrue here cover only the declared short handoff, not SQL implementation or full team review. One valid method example remains below min_class_count=2; base action recovery is separate.
